items.title: Clarence Ford Interview, 1975-12-10
items.q: go by Buster's and 50 cents, and eat like I don't know what

ctx.x: Well I knew it was all live, you know, and you'd cut it as you went. Yeah. So you mean Dave would cut as many things as he could? Sometimes.

He said we'd want to get two sessions out in a day. So if Smiley Lewis would have enough tunes for two sessions, we'd do them. And sometimes we'd do one take and he'd say, I know I can't do it no better than that. And he'd say, what do y'all think? He'd say, no we can't do it any better than that. So that's a take. Now a record at the time I believe would last three minutes. So you'd play three minutes and that's a take. Well suppose you did four tunes in three minutes, twelve minutes, well counting the time it…
How would you do a couple of sessions every week?
